name: maritime-signpost
description: Signpost (not a knowledge pack) for maritime safety and class rules: SOLAS Consolidated Edition 2024 (IH110E) as the paywalled statutory core, ISM Code & Guidelines 2018 (ID117E), ISPS Code 2003 (K116E) and the 2021 guide (IB116E), and COLREGS 2026 (IC904E), with designation, edition, owner, status, and official URL only. Contains no source content. Free-path layers are US flag implementation (eCFR Title 46 and USCG circulars), the USCG Navigation Rules PDF, UK MCA notices under Open Government Licence v3.0, and class portals (DNV, ABS, Bureau Veritas). None of those layers is the IMO consolidated text. No in-repo pack covers these instruments.
